title: Another aerospace company leaves the work in the early 1970s

tellings.quote: my recollection from the senior vice president of the other company is that they kind of uh left that whole line of work

plain: A physicist, Eric Davis, says that a senior vice president of an aerospace company, one he does not name, told him about secret work on studying and copying unknown technology. As Davis recalls it, that company more or less walked away from the whole line of work in the early 1970s, which would mean such programmes once ran inside private industry and some firms dropped out.
